Overall verdict: needs_changes. Implementer target declaration matches `{Repo: DontPanic, Env: dev, Project: (none)}`; structured `target_context` has `env=dev`, `project=null`, and no forbidden command shapes.

FINDING (high, correctness): Upgrade drill-down items are not admitted by the dashboard What Now client vocabulary, so `source="upgrade"` is coerced to `source="capability"` and can disappear in project-scoped views. Evidence: `dashboard/lib/what-now-logic.js` omits `upgrade` from `SOURCES`, `SOURCE_LABELS`, and `SOURCE_PRIORITY`; a direct normalization check returned `{"normalizedSource":"capability","projectVisible":0}` for an `upgrade:r1:req` item. Recommendation: add `upgrade` to the client-side source vocabulary, labels, value-kind labels, sort priority, and regression tests asserting normalize/sort/filter/render preserve `source="upgrade"`.
